scope: Binary64 HiGHS discovery on the fixed 2,113-row design, expanding the 162-column parent pool by ten canonical generators whose reduced-cost scores were independently certified strictly positive with 128-bit Arb. A sub-1/3 result is not a theorem until the exact rationalized candidate passes Arb on all 2,113 rows and a complete 63,133-orbit sixth-order audit. An above-cap result is not a theorem until its rationalized dual is independently Arb-certified against all 172 physical columns.
